description: Public holidays per Swiss canton (official SECO list of cantonal holidays equated with Sundays, Art. 20a ArG; 1 August federal): for a canton and year the dates with weekday, which fall on working days and the bridge days (Monday before a Tuesday holiday, Friday after a Thursday holiday). Cantons that set holidays by area (AG, AI, AR, FR, NE, SO) return one list per area with conditions. Without canton: the number of holidays and bridge days of every canton. Names in DE/FR/IT/EN.
name: public_holidays
